author: Felizia
label: croc3
prompt:
ACTION: standing on top of the gold mound, the dapper crocodile gentleman from image 1 looks down over the edge at a deep pool of gold coins below, and his eyes grow huge and delighted while a happy grin spreads across his snout.
SHOT: medium shot from the front at his eye level, 35mm lens, locked off with a tiny push in on his face.
PLACE: the top of a gold-bar mound overlooking a shimmering pool of loose gold coins and banknotes, a little golden ladder leaning on the mound.
LIGHT: one warm golden key camera-left, about 3:1.
SOUND: a soft sparkling shimmer of coins below, gentle; no voices, no music.
